Une première sur le marché algérien: A first on the Algerian market
Ooredoo Algérie franchit une étape histo: Ooredoo Algeria has reached a historic milestone by lowering the minimum recharge threshold for its Storm solution to 5 Algerian dinars. This unprecedented initiative on the local market now allows customers to top up their Storm credit starting from this minimum amount, directly at the operator's points of sale and dedicated spaces.
Modalités différenciées selon les canaux: Differentiated terms depending on the recharge channels
La flexibilité introduite par Ooredoo va: The flexibility introduced by Ooredoo varies according to the chosen recharge channel. Thus, the minimum threshold of 5 DZD applies only to physical top-ups made at authorized points of sale and the operator's dedicated spaces. For top-ups via the Poste Mobile mobile application, the minimum amount remains set at 10 DZD. As for E-Storm digital top-ups, accessible via electronic payment cards (Gold and CIB), they maintain an unchanged minimum threshold of 100 DZD.
Une stratégie centrée sur l'expérience c: A strategy centered on the customer experience
Cette mesure s'inscrit dans la continuit: This measure is part of Ooredoo's ongoing strategy to place the customer experience, simplicity of use, and proximity at the heart of its services. The operator emphasizes that this initiative meets users' daily needs, offering them complete freedom of choice in the recharge amount, without the constraint of a high threshold.
En abaissant le seuil de recharge Storm: By lowering the Storm recharge threshold to 5 DZD, Ooredoo Algeria has taken a new step in its approach to improving the accessibility of its services. The operator thus reaffirms its commitment to offering solutions that are increasingly simple, flexible, and tailored to the daily expectations of its customers.
Le seuil minimum de recharge Storm passe: The minimum Storm recharge threshold is reduced to 5 DZD for physical top-ups (points of sale and Ooredoo spaces).
Les recharges via l'application Poste Mo: Recharges via the Poste Mobile app remain subject to a minimum threshold of 10 DZD.
Les recharges numériques E-Storm (cartes: E-Storm digital top-ups (Gold/CIB cards) maintain a threshold of 100 DZD.
Cette mesure vise à simplifier l'accès a: This measure aims to simplify access to services and meet the daily needs of customers.
Ooredoo Algérie réaffirme sa stratégie c: Ooredoo Algeria reaffirms its strategy centered on customer experience and flexibility.
